plans.idea: Centered top-to-bottom stack that keeps the original's order: brand mark at the top, then a large two-line headline with its subheadline, then a big bottle, with the CTA directly under the product, all on one central axis.

Product-first story: the bottle fills the full width of the upper half, and a left-aligned text block with the CTA sits below it on one shared left edge, signed off by the brand badge in the bottom-right corner.

Editorial left-flush layout: the brand badge and a large headline block share the top-left edge, the bottle sits big in the lower middle, and the CTA is anchored bottom-left on the same edge as the text, so the eye zig-zags from brand to message to product to action.
